reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Skin Booster 200ml
reviews.text: I'm repurchasing this now after buying it on my trip but it just adds another layer of moisture for dry days and plumps my skin up really nicely!
reviews.zh: 我而家再買，之前旅行時已經買過一次。乾燥嘅日子，佢會再加一層水分，令皮膚飽滿咗好多！

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Skin Booster 200ml
reviews.text:
さらっとしたテクスチャーで肌になじみやすく、ベタつかないのにしっかりうるおいます。

洗顔後に使うと肌がしっとりして、その後のスキンケアもなじみやすくなる感じがします。乾燥が気になるときにも使いやすく、毎日の保湿ケアに欠かせないアイテムです。
reviews.zh:
質地清爽，容易吸收入皮膚，唔會黏，但係保濕效果好足。

洗面之後用，皮膚會變得水潤，之後嘅護膚產品都比較容易吸收嘅感覺。覺得乾燥嗰陣都好好用，係每日保濕護理嘅必備物品。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Skin Booster 200ml
reviews.text: Repeat purchase as it’s very good for boosting hydration
reviews.zh: 再買，因為補水效果非常好。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Skin Booster 200ml
reviews.text: Love this skin booster so much due to the amazing hydration it gives to my skin. I had to recommend it to my friend due to how amazing it’s made my skin feel moisturised and absorbed really well.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款 skin booster，因為佢令我皮膚補水效果好驚人。我要推薦畀朋友，因為佢令我皮膚感覺好滋潤，吸收都好好。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Skin Booster 200ml
reviews.text: It feels incredibly refreshing yet hydrating. I can't go a day without it.
reviews.zh: 感覺非常清爽，但又好保濕。我一日都唔可以冇佢。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Skin Booster 200ml
reviews.text: It has a milky-gel or watery texture. After applying, it absorbs quickly and leaves no stickiness at all, making it perfect for Hong Kong’s humid weather.
reviews.zh: 質地似奶凍或者水狀。塗咗之後吸收好快，完全唔會黏，所以好啱香港潮濕嘅天氣。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Skin Booster 200ml
reviews.text: 這是一款補水＋屏障保濕的玻尿酸化狀水，此款化妝水質地比一般化妝水還濃稠，不是單純水感質地，搽起來非常保濕，已是第二次回購，且這是購買的是升級版，推推
